description: Bearded caveman in yellow tunic with black leopard spots and jagged hem; redrawn in a new pose or expression in nearly every scene (not identical reuse); same face and line weight.
Caveman in brown leopard tunic holding a stick or hugging a goat; appears only early.
Caveman with black sunglasses and open-mouth grin, arms out; drawn twice (G0068 and G0176 redrawn with slightly different TV tilt) plus arms-crossed variant in G0076.
Caveman with furry ears and bushy tail, hands clasped, sly smile; single use.
Caveman grinning on stone throne with hands steepled; G0120 left-facing and G0126 mirrored/larger redraw; reused small on coin wallpaper in G0128.
Caveman with oversized brain on head reading tablet then laughing on coin mound.
Naked caveman, sad, black circle on belly and censor bar; G0148 to G0151 and redrawn at smaller size in G0174.
Yellow caveman holding white goat; appears with question mark and with red X; same pose reused with overlay.
Caveman with round glasses: laughing with coil (G0142) and sweating anxious (G0146).

One-off caveman poses: handshake pair, thumbs-down group of four, rock-sharing pair, mammoth hunter, digger, hand-holding pair, flag-holder, homeless under tent, ankle-hurt, shocked sitter, piggyback pair, teacher, kneeling worshipper, gift giver, cloak holder, thumbs-up.
Large seated frowning caveman in yellow tunic right of market stall with green check.
Long-bearded robed old figure: stern with hands steepled, laughing with crystal ball, arms spread; line-only no colour.
Translucent light-blue caveman with arms spread; drifts up and out of frame.
Dark charcoal-textured rendering of a menacing grinning caveman with club; stylistically different from the flat cartoon art everywhere else; shown at five scales.
Round yellow smiling character (Corporation) with stubby limbs; waving, paying dollar, kissing, eating, then absent.
Red triangle with face and legs; bride with veil, being eaten, then grinning wearing yellow limbs.
Large alarm clock with hands spinning for 51 frames.
White goat held by caveman; scared expression in G0008.
Long wooden stick used as trade item then club.
Gold coin with caveman profile; singles above huts, three in hand, pile of about nine, mound, full-frame wallpaper.
Same cluster of nine coins reused identically (apparent copy) at left in market scene and again in the afterlife scene.
Three thatched huts with wavy hills; separate jungle scene of three treehouses with ladders; coins pop onto both.
Rounded-rectangle bubble with thick outline and downward tail; words appended one at a time, left aligned, second line indented.
Bold black hand-lettered all-caps (comic-like) on plain white; used for BUT ONE DAY, CAPITALISM, EMPLOYEE, LESSON, FOR RENT, FREE.
Word 'CAPITALISM' reused five times: small, big (scale pop), on running legs, small with tilted LISM, large CAPITA with small LISM.
Large red X drawn over an object to show negation; same X shape reused.
Green check mark popping above the seated caveman.
Cracked-screen TV, armchair, radio; shown in two scenes with similar layout.
Eight black-outline objects: TV, fork, radio, headphones, bone, phone, wolf, guitar.
Product sequence: river, water bottle with caveman label, skull cave, wind swirls, round Air+ bottle; each drawn alone centred.
Pole sign 'FOR RENT' and tilted sign 'FREE'.
Box with legs running, labelled CAPITALISM.
Small stone market stall.
Yellow 'hello my name is' sticker; text typed in.
Black chalkboard with white text 'LESSON'.
Crystal ball on stump in front of robed god.
Yellow peace symbol beneath red X.
Wrapped sack tied with yellow ribbon.
Stone frame with picture of smiling couple; last visual before fade to white.
American flag with block, sparking coil, torn lean-to with 'WILL HUNT FOR FIRE' sign.
Fade from white into charcoal portrait at start of G0011 and fade of photo frame to white at the end; the only two true fades.
Black 'HA HA HA' laugh text near laughing characters; same text style.
